attempts.summary: Configured sudo command logging on node1 to /var/log/sudo-commands.log via a validated /etc/sudoers.d/sudo-command-logging drop-in (Defaults logfile=..., log_year, log_host, !syslog), which records user, host, timestamp, and full command for every sudo invocation while suppressing sudo's syslog/authpriv output so entries never reach /var/log/secure or journald. Verified with both root and a disposable test user. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a background-acknowledged systemctl reboot, confirmed the node went unreachable then came back with a new boot_id, and confirmed the sudoers config, log file, and exclusion from the general system log all survived and continued working post-reboot.
